topic: Finalizing privacy policy pages and links
summary_markdown:
The session focused on reviewing, refining, and deploying the company's privacy policy documentation for multiple regions. Initial work involved updating a Latvian (LV) privacy page, which was confirmed to be ready for release via a direct link.

Several structural decisions were made regarding the main corporate privacy policy (`/privacy/privacy-policy`):
*   The standard text and links in the footer and on the Privacy page must revert to the original, approved version.
*   The Latvian page should remain separate and only be accessible via a direct link (e.g., for QR code generation).

Stylistic changes included:
*   Replacing arrow symbols (`🡪`) with standard dots or dashes.
*   Adjusting text formatting to 'tighten' the spacing across all sections, making it consistent with list styles.
*   Changing the main title from "Privacy policy" to "Privacy Notice".

The final approved version of the corporate privacy policy was confirmed for release.
decisions: The Latvian privacy page should be released as a standalone document accessible only via direct link.
The standard corporate Privacy Policy (`/privacy/privacy-policy`) must revert to its original, approved text and links.
All instances of the main policy title in the footer and on the Privacy page must use 'Privacy Notice'.
Styling changes include replacing arrow symbols with dots/dashes and tightening general text spacing.
action_items: Deploy the Latvian privacy page to production.
Ensure the corporate Privacy Policy uses the approved standard text.
